subject: 平遥城墙 · 迎薰门及相邻墙段
author: Yumeto
source_note: 2025年迎薰门实拍；所绘是中央墙段，左右淡出表示局部延续，不是完整六公里城垣。门楼不以1370作为单体确切建年。
prompt: One fine-line heritage illustration for 访古, matching image 1 STYLE MASTER: delicate sparse slightly organic black contours and huge white planes, no shading. Image 2 is the actual photographed monument GEOMETRY, not style. Preserve roof type, structural bay count, openings, silhouette and platform. BLACK thin lines on PURE WHITE. No filled openings, gray, hatching, texture, color, labels or frame. Remove trees, people, umbrellas, signs, banners, offerings and plaque lettering. Landscape 1536x1024, complete selected architecture centered within generous 12% white side margins. Roof and walls remain mostly WHITE with only 3 or 4 suggestion strokes, not dense tile or brick patterns. Draw the visible south front of Yingxun Gate in Pingyao City Wall. This is a SELECTED WALL SEGMENT, not the entire city. Very wide low massive masonry wall with regular crenellations, a single central arched portal opening and shallow rectangular surround, and the photographed two eaves of the distant timber gatehouse rising behind the middle crenellated wall. Preserve the real occlusion: no invented gatehouse columns below the parapet and no duplicated gatehouse. Include about five or six merlons each side, let wall terminate cleanly at side margins. The masonry wall is largely blank, only sparse short block joints near the arch. Keep the arched tunnel white, no scenery beyond it. Delete memorial stele, modern boards, all people and bushes. Keep low-eye front view like photograph; no invented bastions or side towers.

site_recommendation.name: 平遥城墙
site_recommendation.lede: 迎薰门从南面打开古城的轮廓，券洞、城台与门楼上下叠合。沿着垛口展开的墙身，把街巷与田野分在城内城外。
facts: 城墙于明洪武三年（1370）扩建并包砖，现貌经历明清及近现代修缮。
图版选南门迎薰门和左右相邻墙段，保留门洞与上方重檐门楼。
平遥古城与双林寺、镇国寺共同列入世界遗产；本条单记城墙，不与寺院重复计数。
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1370用于城垣扩建阶段排序；门楼与现存墙面包含后世修缮。
